blocks.orig: The Lion’s Paw Camp nestles in between a grove of acacia trees on the eastern rim of the Ngorongoro crater. The camp has 8 spacious ensuite tents on wooden platforms with fixed roofs, all boasting a classic decor with lush beds and fancy bathrooms. The bottom of the crater is just a 10-minute drive away, but from the camp, you already get a taste of it due to the marvellous views. The scenic wood-and-glass restaurant offers the possibility to eat inside or on the large terrace with a view, but if you feel romantic you can also choose to dine in your room. Lion’s Paw is a great place to stay before or after your descent into the crater, where you enjoy all the luxury you need while you are surrounded by some of the most ancient nature one can find on this earth.
blocks.html: Set within a grove of acacia trees on the eastern rim of the Ngorongoro crater, you find the Lion’s Paw Camp. It has 8 spacious ensuite tents on wooden platforms under fixed roofs, each with classic decor, sumptuous beds and stylish bathrooms. The crater floor is only a 10-minute drive away, and thanks to the wonderful views you already get a first impression of it from the camp. In the attractive wood-and-glass restaurant you can dine indoors or on the large terrace with a view, and if you are in a romantic mood you can also have dinner in your room. Lion’s Paw is an excellent place to stay before or after you go down into the crater, offering all the luxury you need while you are surrounded by some of the oldest nature on earth.
